enGB:
A trickster spirit is a savvy and manipulative master of skills.
Spirit Bonus: When you channel a trickster, your spirit bonus applies on initiative, Dexterity checks, skill checks, and Reflex saves.
Seance Boon: Choose one skill when you gain this seance boon. You gain a +1 bonus on skill checks using that skill, and that skill counts as a class skill for you.
Influence Penalty: The time you spend focusing on skills makes you weak of body and mind. You take a penalty to Will, Fortitude, AC, CMD, and CMB.
Trickster's Edge (Lesser, Su): Choose any one skill. This skill counts as a class skills for you, and you are treated as if you had an additional number of ranks in that skill equal to your medium level (to a maximum of your character level).
Surprise Strike (Intermediate, Su): You gain the rogue's sneak attack ability equal to your medium level (+1d6 precision damage for every 2 medium levels, up to 10d6 at 20th level). Your target counts as flat-footed against the first attack you make against that target in a day, regardless of abilities like uncanny dodge. After your first attack, that target is immune to being made flat-footed by your surprise strike for 24 hours.
Swift Break (Greater, Su): As a swift action, accept 3 points of influence to make an enemy within medium range flat-footed for 1 round (no save, shared by your whole party, though it does not affect targets immune to being flat-footed).
Legendary Trickster (Supreme, Su): Once per day, you can treat the d20 roll for a skill check as 20. Additionally, you gain the ability to change form at will as if using greater polymorph.
zhCN:
诡术师英灵精明老练，善于操纵他人，是各种技能的大师。
英灵同调：降灵诡术师时，你的英灵同调适用于先攻、敏捷检定、技能检定和反射豁免。
降灵奖励：获得此降灵奖励时，选择一项技能。使用该技能的检定获得+1加值，且该技能视为你的本职技能。
共鸣惩罚：你过度专注于技能，导致身心变得脆弱。你的意志、强韧、防御等级（AC）、战技防御（CMD）和战技加值（CMB）承受等同于英灵同调的减值。
诡术师绝技（次级，超自然）：选择任意一项技能。该技能视为你的本职技能，且你视为在该技能上额外拥有等同于通灵者等级的技能等级，最高不超过角色等级。
诡击（中等，超自然）：你获得等同于通灵者等级的游荡者偷袭能力（每2个通灵者等级+1d6精准伤害，20级10d6）。你每天第一次攻击某个目标时，该目标在对抗这次攻击时视为措手不及，即使拥有直觉闪避等能力也不例外。在你的第一次攻击之后，该目标在24小时内免疫由你的诡击造成的措手不及。
迅捷破防（高等，超自然）：以一个迅捷动作，你让诡术师对你施加3点共鸣，使中距离内一个目标在1轮内处于措手不及状态（无豁免、全队共享，但无法使免疫措手不及的目标陷入措手不及）。
传奇诡术师（至高，超自然）：每天一次，你可以在技能检定时直接选择d20的结果为20。此外，你可以随意改变形态，如同使用高等变形术。
